title: Zarr v3 metadata (zarr.json)
description: A Zarr v3 array or group metadata document. See https://zarr-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/v3/core/index.html

ZarrV3ArrayMetadataJSON.description: Schema input for a v3 array document, including arbitrary extensions.

zarr_format.title: Zarr Format
zarr_format.description: The Zarr format version. Always the integer 3.

node_type.title: Node Type
node_type.description: The node kind. Always "array" for array metadata.

data_type.title: Data Type
data_type.description: The data type of the array's elements, e.g. "float64" or a {"name", "configuration"} object for parameterized types.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: The dimensions of the array: one non-negative integer per axis.

chunk_grid.title: Chunk Grid
chunk_grid.description: How the array is divided into chunks. The core spec defines the "regular" grid, configured with a "chunk_shape".

chunk_key_encoding.title: Chunk Key Encoding
chunk_key_encoding.description: How chunk grid indices map to store keys. The core spec defines "default" (separator "/") and "v2" (separator ".").

fill_value.description: The value used for unwritten regions of the array. Its permitted JSON shape depends on data_type (e.g. "NaN" or a hex string for floats).

codecs.title: Codecs
codecs.description: The codec pipeline applied to each chunk, in order: zero or more array→array codecs, exactly one array→bytes codec, then zero or more bytes→bytes codecs.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Arbitrary user metadata for this array.

storage_transformers.title: Storage Transformers
storage_transformers.description: Storage transformers applied between the codec pipeline and the store. Rarely used; an empty list is equivalent to absence.

dimension_names.title: Dimension Names
dimension_names.description: An optional name (or null) for each dimension. Must have exactly one entry per dimension of shape.

ZarrV3ArrayMetadataJSON.title: ZarrV3ArrayMetadataJSON

ZarrV3ConsolidatedMetadataJSON.description: Schema input for the closed inline consolidated-metadata envelope.
ZarrV3ConsolidatedMetadataJSON.title: ZarrV3ConsolidatedMetadataJSON

ZarrV3GroupMetadataJSON.description: Schema input for a v3 group document, including arbitrary extensions.

zarr_format.title: Zarr Format
zarr_format.description: The Zarr format version. Always the integer 3.

node_type.title: Node Type
node_type.description: The node kind. Always "group" for group metadata.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Arbitrary user metadata for this group.

consolidated_metadata.description: Inline consolidated metadata: a snapshot of every child document, embedded by the reference implementation. Not part of the v3 core spec.

ZarrV3GroupMetadataJSON.title: ZarrV3GroupMetadataJSON

ZarrV3MandatoryNamedConfigJSON.description: Closed named configuration accepted where understanding is mandatory.
ZarrV3MandatoryNamedConfigJSON.title: ZarrV3MandatoryNamedConfigJSON

ZarrV3NamedConfigJSON.description: Closed v3 named configuration accepted at optional extension points.
